# Nero Development

> Nero Development provides professional egocentric (first-person) video training data for humanoid robotics and embodied-AI models. Data is captured by professional residential cleaning crews during real shifts, producing multi-hour, unconstrained footage that is dense in hand-object interaction and delivered with full privacy compliance.

## What we offer

- **Egocentric training data** for humanoid robots and manipulation/dexterity models.
- **Source:** professional cleaning crews performing real, unscripted work in real homes — naturally dense, continuous hand-object manipulation with high environmental variance.
- **End-to-end pipeline owned by Nero:** crew deployment, capture, PII sanitization, and SLA-backed delivery. None of it is the buyer's operational problem.

## Capture specifications

- **Resolution / frame rate:** 4K at 60 fps (H.264 / H.265), continuous recording with no manual stop/start.
- **Session length:** 2–6 hours per session — the full cleaning shift, not edited highlights.
- **Sensors:** 6-DoF, with per-frame synchronized IMU and structured-light depth streams (depth range 0.5–5.0 m).
- **Diversity:** 500+ unique residential homes. Q3 target: 10,000 hours delivered.

## What we capture

- **Hand-object interactions** — grasping, lifting, wiping, scrubbing, pouring with bottles, cloths, tools, and containers.
- **Household cleaning tasks** — surface wiping, vacuuming, appliance interaction; long-horizon sequences with labeled action primitives and task progress.
- **Room navigation** — kitchen, bathroom, and living-area traversal through doorways and around furniture across diverse real homes.

## Privacy & compliance

- **Biometric releases** — written consent from all crew members (gait, hand geometry, facial incidentals).
- **Property access releases** — homeowners sign filming releases before any session.
- **Automated PII blurring** — every frame processed for faces, screens, text, and identifiable documents; redaction logs delivered with each dataset.
- **Licensing** — exclusive licensing available (Nero does not resell, repurpose, or retain copies); shared licensing also available.

## Engagement

- Nero is onboarding enterprise buyers and aligning Q3 capture protocols. Pilot contracts and MSAs are supported with throughput commitments.
- **Contact for pilots and licensing:** inquiries@nerodevelopment.com
